ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a phosphate/phosphonate-like transition-state structure, with two identical CF3CH2O–P substituents on the left; the central phosphorus atom is also connected to one P=O and one carbon-chain fragment. The right carbon chain is connected to a carbonyl C=O and has an OMe ester group. There is also a base fragment N(SiMe3)2 below, carrying a negative sign; arrows in the figure are not counted in the bond count, and bonds involving hydrogen are also not counted. Reasoning and counting: Count by fragments. In each CF3CH2O–P substituent, non-hydrogen bonds include 3 C–F, 1 C–C, 1 C–O, and 1 O–P, totaling 6; two such substituents total 12. In the remaining phosphate/enol/ester core, the connections counted without duplication are P=O, P–C, C–C to carbonyl, C=O, C–O, and O–Me, totaling 6. In the base fragment N(SiMe3)2, there are 2 N–Si bonds, plus a total of 6 Si–Me bonds in the two SiMe3, totaling 8. The total is 12 + 6 + 8 = 26.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown.

method.method_draft: Describe the image, then count by fragments. Count the two CF3CH2O-P substituents: 6 non-H bonds each, giving 12. Count the remaining phosphonate/enolate/ester core connections not already counted: P=O, P-C, C-C to carbonyl, C=O, C-O, and O-Me = 6. Count the base fragment N(SiMe3)2: two N-Si bonds plus six Si-Me bonds = 8. Add all components: 12 + 6 + 8 = 26.

推理计数：按片段计数。每个 CF3CH2O–P 取代基中，非氢键包括 3 个 C–F、1 个 C–C、1 个 C–O、1 个 O–P，共 6 个；两个这样的取代基共 12 个。剩余的磷酸酯/烯醇/酯核心中，不重复计入的连接为 P=O、P–C、C–C 到羰基、C=O、C–O、O–Me，共 6 个。碱片段 N(SiMe3)2 中，有 2 个 N–Si 键，加上两个 SiMe3 中共 6 个 Si–Me 键，合计 8 个。总数为 12 + 6 + 8 = 26。

method.method_draft: Describe the image, then make a heavy-atom adjacency tally. The two CF3CH2O substituents contribute degree sum 22 total. The central/ester atoms add: P degree 4, oxo O 1, alpha C 2, carbonyl C 3, carbonyl O 1, ester O 2, methoxy C 1. The N(SiMe3)2 unit adds N degree 2, two Si atoms degree 4 each, and six methyl carbons degree 1 each. Total heavy-atom degree sum is 52, so the number of non-H bonds is 52/2 = 26.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个过渡态/反应结构，左侧有两个 CF3CH2O 取代基连到磷原子，磷原子还与一个氧原子形成 P=O，并与中间的 α-碳相连。α-碳再连到羰基碳，羰基碳与羰基氧相连，并与 OMe 酯基相连。图的右下方有一个带负电的 N(SiMe3)2 单元。图中有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头；含氢键也不计入。

再推理：用重原子邻接度求和来计数非氢键，每条非氢键会被两个端点各计一次，所以最后除以 2。两个 CF3CH2O 取代基的重原子度数合计为 22。中心/酯部分的重原子度数为：P 的度数 4，P=O 中的氧度数 1，α-碳度数 2，羰基碳度数 3，羰基氧度数 1，酯氧度数 2，甲氧基碳度数 1，合计 4 + 1 + 2 + 3 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 14。N(SiMe3)2 单元的重原子度数为：N 度数 2，两个 Si 各为 4 共 8，六个甲基碳各为 1 共 6，合计 2 + 8 + 6 = 16。总重原子度数为 22 + 14 + 16 = 52，因此非氢键总数为 52 / 2 = 26。
